posts.text: This is not a monopoly but government granting permission to one PSU company currently. Nothing stops government from opening up this sector. E.g. Only private tour train does its own booking. South Star Rail As more private trains will get introduced govt may be required to open up CRIS based booking engine to others (similar to airlines booking) so that booking happens across multiple operators or they will have to onboard other trains. Even otherwise if service level goes down govt can introduce other players.
